reviews.text:
I would like to express how much we appreciated the help Marion provided.

Indeed, through her training, active listening, advice, and kind approach, she helped us progress without being dogmatic and with a touch of humor.
We made significant progress in training our puppy thanks to Marion's insightful analysis in a calm and peaceful environment. I highly recommend seeking her help, as it saves us time and adds extra enjoyment for our dog!

Be vigilant if you don't want your pet featured online and if you don't want to be insulted.
This is a negative review for me because Marion posted a photo of my pet on her website without asking me beforehand or without my consent. It's my little black cat with yellow-green eyes, lying on my hardwood floor, with the wooden legs of my dining room table and its white wall visible in the background.
She deliberately ignores my request to remove the photo and insults me when I report it.
My little cat Pristy is thrilled that I'm going on holiday to spend time with Marion, who takes such good care of her. She's available and accommodating, thank you so much :)

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Marion is a fantastic trainer! Always gentle and positive with dogs. My Ulk has made tremendous progress and loves coming to the sessions. Leaving her is …
Marion looked after my two cats for two weeks this summer and everything went very well. …

Marion has a rare humanity and kindness towards animals.

She took care of our three cats, one of whom was sick, as if they were her own.
I recommend her without hesitation!

We hired Marion for a few dog walking sessions.
Marion quickly won over our energetic 2-year-old dog.
He was so happy to welcome her along for the walk!
A fantastic experience for both of us!
Marion was a great help with my dog. I highly recommend her!
